**10. Portfolio Direction?**

Bonds: mixed — HYG (1W: +0.20% | 1M: +0.73%) ABOVE TREND vs LQD (1W: -0.69% | 1M: +0.03%) CORRECTION.

HYG (1W: +0.20% | 1M: +0.73%) ABOVE TREND vs LQD (1W: -0.69% | 1M: +0.03%) CORRECTION — watch HYG/LQD for credit stress. XLK (1W: -0.15% | 1M: +0.76%) CORRECTION / XLF (1W: +1.39% | 1M: +7.24%) ABOVE TREND — watch relative pivot for style rotation.

Key risk is minor divergence—XLK (1W: -0.15% | 1M: +0.76%) CORRECTION and TLT (1W: -1.20% | 1M: +0.22%) CORRECTION; monitor VXX (1W: -3.32% | 1M: -12.84%) BELOW TREND for any volatility pickup.
